findings.claim: 'A task counts as done only when its shipped test passes unchanged' dangled 'unchanged' after the verb and used the singular although html-and-css Task 5 is covered by two shipped tests (same sentence in all four READMEs).
findings.recommendation: Rephrase: 'A task counts as done only when the shipped tests for it pass exactly as shipped.'

items.note: All four READMEs read 'A task counts as done only when the shipped tests for it pass exactly as shipped': the plural covers html-and-css Task 5's two shipped tests, 'exactly as shipped' unambiguously modifies the tests, and 'only when' stays a necessary condition compatible with fetch Task 7.

Re-staling is a hash-binding artifact only: since the closing rechecks the sole change to this lab is one README sentence (commit b1d7c974 touches only coding-lab/README.md here; starter/ and tests/ are byte-identical to the closed state). The new sentence lists fixed-support file names and the pass criterion and discloses no declaration, rule or markup; every task still gives Where/Outcome/Done-when plus staged hints that name the kind of construct without the completed rule, and test names and failure messages remain outcome-oriented.
